# XiliHerb

> XiliHerb Naturals Pvt Ltd is a science-driven biotechnology startup based in Bangalore, India. It converts low-value agricultural biomass — primarily non-GMO corn cob residue — into high-value, sustainable bio-based ingredients through enzymatic bioconversion. Its first validated output is xylitol, produced via enzymatic hydrolysis of corn cob hemicellulose at ambient temperature, without harsh acid catalysts.

## Entity

- Legal name: XiliHerb Naturals Pvt Ltd
- Brand: XiliHerb
- Founded: 2026, Bangalore, India
- Stage: Lab-scale validation, advancing toward pilot and commercial production

## Process

XiliHerb's core technology converts non-GMO corn cob hemicellulose into bio-based xylitol through enzymatic hydrolysis — no harsh acid catalysts, ambient temperature, near-zero feedstock cost. Corn cobs represent roughly 40% of the harvestable plant by dry weight and are naturally rich in xylan (30–35%). The same feedstock also yields arabinoxylan and lignin derivatives. AI-assisted process modelling is used to accelerate enzyme activity analysis and reduce experimental iteration cycles.
